caption: Lama Monachile, Polignano a Mare
composition: White cliff town above the turquoise cove · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the cliff-top terrace, the camera looks down into Lama Monachile's narrow cove in the brightening 08:05 morning. The whitewashed old town of Polignano a Mare climbs the cliff at the upper left, an arched Roman bridge spans the inlet at center, and the pebble beach curves beneath it where the turquoise water meets the shore. Layered limestone cliffs close in on the right, a weathered stone parapet anchors the lower-left foreground, and broken clouds drift over the calm sea beyond.
